theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Consumer Staples (+1.01%) and Materials (+0.77%) led the market today, while Financials (-1.97%) and Communication Svcs (-0.41%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.13%, defensives +0.69%, and value/cyclicals -0.16% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.01%, Dow -0.51%, Nasdaq +0.27% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.27%. The VIX fell 3.16% to 14.39, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.22% to $4,369.40, crude oil was little changed at $91.64, and bitcoin slipped 0.29% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
